# nemau export

Export the project's infrastructure as Terraform.

Produces three files:

```
nemau.tf        the resources, with dependencies expressed as Terraform
                references
imports.tf      "import" blocks (Terraform 1.5+) to adopt what exists
                instead of recreating it
inventory.json  the raw inventory exactly as the API returned it
```

A subnet refers to its network as "nemau_network.app.id", for example. The
configuration therefore replays into an empty project, or can be adapted to
another provider.

This command does not export the contents of object containers (see
"nemau storage export") or instance disks, which the API does not expose.

## Usage

```
nemau export [directory] [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --imports      also write the Terraform import blocks (default true)
  -d, --out string   destination directory (default: the current directory)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
